notes.title: The massive 2.0 update introduces new missions, maps, level progression, and a tower defense mode
notes.content:
Thought you mastered Zombie Bloxx? Think again: this update is a total game changer! Now you can complete a gauntlet of challenging missions to beat levels and earn Stars. The more missions you complete, the more Stars you earn, and the closer you are to unlocking a new map and character! Each map has 2 Bonus Levels where you can win Gems galore. Plus test out your tower defense skills with an array of deadly weapons in a special summer event: Undead-pendence Day!

In this update:
• Level Progression: Win Stars to unlock new maps!
• 2 Bonus Levels per map
• New Missions
• Undead-pendence Day: Protect American monuments from zombie hordes in this tower defense mode!

notes.title: Update 1.4 The Eggs-ecutioner Has Arrived
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31146953/e5459dd84e9e4f5fb72f54960ad2c9e1db3e65e0.jpg[/img]

Spring has sprung, and that means the Easter Bunny is here to kick some zombie tail! This adorably dangerous new character has its own unique weapon with the power to devastate hordes of zombies. You’ll will need to act fast if you’re chasing the rabbit: it will only be available for a limited time!

[b]The Hunt Is On[/b]
Hoping to control the criminally cute Easter Bunny? You’ll need to keep their eyes peeled all event long for Easter eggs hidden throughout Zombie Bloxx. Once you’ve found all 7 Easter eggs, you can finally unlock the Easter Bunny. Finding an Easter egg will reset a timer counting down to the appearance of the next egg, so you need to be quick on your feet to find them all — hop to it!

notes.title: Update 1.3: More characters, more weapons, more mayhem!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31146953/c94c349d7245594c4b2a398deac9ed5fc59d5683.png[/img]

Think escaping hordes of zombies was tough before? Think again! We’ve increased zombie spawn rates in this update, which means you’ll be facing bigger hordes than ever before. But don’t go crying to your mama just yet: we’ve also added a new weapon and three new characters to help you survive. Plus, weapons will now drop more often, so you’ll never be left defenseless!

In this update:
• Three new characters: Ryder, Synth, and Clowney!
• Ryder is available for free
• New weapon: Machine Gun!
• Increased zombie spawn rate
• Increased weapon drop rate
• Bug fixes and optimizations

notes.title: Come Celebrate a Merry Z-mas and Nuclear New Year!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31146953/a7e8542dc242d250acafbfec5a7c482371f3b565.png[/img]

The holiday celebration is in full swing with today's Zombie Bloxx Z-mas update! We’ve redecorated the city map for some extra holiday cheer, and trapped a new victim...we mean hero in the city for you to play with! 

Santa is surprisingly fast for a man his size, and he’s ready to slaughter zombie hordes with his Rocket Sled. Don’t let the trail of sparkles and flames fool you, the Rocket Sled is the perfect way to boost up your high score.

So go smash some undead skulls open and spread Z-mas cheer to everyone!

notes.title: Zombie Bloxx is Now Available on Steam
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31146953/ed4b48217514bef1c276ea463e27bab68c446027.jpg[/img]

Big Blue Bubble is proud to announce that their newest title Zombie Bloxx is now available on Steam. This is the first Steam launch from Big Blue Bubble and the third title in its growing worldwide publishing initiative.

Zombie Bloxx is a 3D survival runner published by Big Blue Bubble. As players progress through the game they will unlock different characters - each with their own way of taking down zombies. From disco balls and chainsaws to baseball bats and unicorns, these are just some of the tools players can use to defeat zombies and earn their achievements.

“We’re excited to be publishing in a new gaming genre,” stated Big Blue Bubble founder and CEO Damir Slogar. “Our collaboration on Zombie Bloxx with Roosh has resulted in a game that we’re quite happy with and we’re sure players will
be too.”

Zombie Bloxx is available to download now on mobile through Apple’s App Store, Google Play and Steam. To learn more about Zombie Bloxx and download the app visit [url=http://www.bigbluebubble.com/games/Zombie-Bloxx/] www.bigbluebubble.com/games/Zombie-Bloxx	[/url]
